services.title: Vehicular Recovery and Rescue Services
services.short: 24-hour breakdown and accident recovery in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.
services.sub: AA Rescue recovers broken-down and accident vehicles day and night in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.
services.lead: Our rescue teams give comfort and remove distress for stranded motorists. We recover your vehicle safely and take it where you need it to go.
points: Recovery of broken-down and accident vehicles
Flatbed trucks that protect your car in transit
Coverage in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt
features: Engine, gearbox or electrical failure on the road. We tow or lift your vehicle to a safe place.
Safe removal of damaged vehicles from the scene.
Flat tyre, flat battery, fuel or lock-out support where possible.
We take the vehicle to your mechanic, home or workshop.
steps: Share your location and what happened.
The nearest rescue unit is sent to you.
Your vehicle is loaded and delivered to your chosen destination.
faqs: Which cities do you cover?
Rescue is available 24 hours in Lagos, Abuja and Port Harcourt. For other locations, call us and we will advise.
Is the service available at night and on holidays?
Yes. Our team works every day of the year, including major holidays.
Can you move many vehicles at once?
Yes, see our multi-loader haulage service for intercity movement of several vehicles.

services.title: Drivers Outsourcing
services.short: Recruitment, training and outsourcing of tested drivers for homes and companies.
services.sub: We recruit, train and outsource tested drivers to private clients and corporate bodies.
services.lead: Every driver is tested and verified before placement, so you hire with confidence.
points: Recruitment, training and placement in one service
Replacement support when you need it
features: Polished, discreet chauffeurs for senior staff and families.
Reliable drivers for company vehicles and shared fleets.
Drivers with police or escort training for higher-risk routes.
steps: Type of driver, number and location.
Verified drivers matched to your brief.
You interview, we onboard and support.
faqs: Are drivers background checked?
Drivers are tested and verified before placement. Ask our team about the specific checks for your category.
Can you supply drivers in bulk?
Yes. Tell us the quantity and start date in the request form.

services.title: Learner Driver's Training
services.short: Learn to drive with experienced instructors and well-kept training cars.
services.sub: AA Rescue is a pioneer of modern driving training in Nigeria. Safety is always the first lesson.
services.lead: From first-time learners to nervous returners, our instructors build real road skills step by step.
features: Controls, road signs and first drives in a safe setting.
Rebuild confidence after a long break.
Traffic, parking, junctions and highway driving.
Know what to expect on test day.
steps: Choose a programme and start date.
Practical lessons with a trained instructor.
Finish ready for the road and your licence.
faqs: Do I need my own car?
No. Training vehicles are provided.
Can I choose automatic or manual?
Tell us your preference in the form and we will advise on availability.

services.title: Testing and Certification of Drivers
services.short: Skills testing and certification for corporate bodies and individuals.
services.sub: We test and certify drivers for corporate bodies and individuals.
services.lead: A structured assessment gives employers evidence of skill and gives drivers a credential they can show.
points: Assessments for individuals and corporate teams
Certification you can present to employers
features: Assess your own driving and get certified.
Test whole driver teams before hiring or renewals.
steps: Pick a date for one driver or a group.
faqs: Can a company test all its drivers?
Yes. Enter the number of drivers in the form and we will arrange a schedule.
What if a driver fails?
We recommend suitable training and can retest after it.

services.title: Defensive and Advanced Drivers Training
services.short: Defensive and advanced driving for executives, drivers and corporate fleets.
services.sub: Capacity building for drivers and executives, from defensive driving to advanced skills.
services.lead: Training that cuts risk, damage and downtime for individuals and company fleets.
points: Advanced skills for executives and chauffeurs
features: Control, hazard handling and refined technique.
Tailored sessions for your fleet team.
steps: Tell us your team size and goals.
Practical and theory sessions with trainers.
faqs: Can you train at our premises?
Ask our team. Enter your location in the notes and we will advise.
Is it suitable for beginners?
It is best for people who already drive. New drivers should start with Learner Training.

services.title: General Goods and Equipment Logistics
services.short: Clearing, haulage and delivery of goods and equipment.
services.sub: Clearing at Nigerian airports, equipment haulage and general goods logistics.
services.lead: One partner for clearing, transport and delivery, so your cargo moves without the stress.
features: Clearing services at airports across Nigeria.
Heavy equipment moved safely by flatbed.
Move cars across the country with our multi-loader rigs.
steps: What, how big and where to.
faqs: Can you move vehicles too?
Yes. Use our dedicated vehicle haulage booking page.
How do I get a price?
Fill the form with pickup, delivery and goods details.

services.title: Corporate Transportation
services.short: A wide range of vehicles for staff, executives and events.
services.sub: A wide range of vehicles with state-of-the-art facilities for businesses.
services.lead: Staff shuttles, executive cars and event transport with trained drivers and reliable vehicles.
features: Group movement for conferences and occasions.
faqs: Do vehicles come with drivers?
Yes, or without. Choose what suits you in the enquiry.
Can you handle one-off events?
Yes. Tell us the date and guest count.

services.title: Drivers Academy
services.short: A 2-day programme with practical and theory training.
services.sub: Usually a 2-day programme combining practical sessions and theory.
services.lead: A focused short course that raises the standard of driving for individuals and organisations.
points: Open to individuals and corporate groups
features: Core defensive techniques and road safety.
Book a cohort for your company.
steps: Two days of theory and practice.
faqs: How long is the programme?
It is usually a 2-day programme.
Can companies send many drivers?
Yes. Add the number of participants in the notes.

services.title: Fleet Management
services.short: Corporate fleet acquisition, leasing and management.
services.sub: Corporate fleet acquisition, leasing and management under one roof.
services.lead: Cut downtime and cost with one partner for vehicles, drivers, recovery and tracking.
points: Drivers, recovery and tracking in one place
features: Source the right vehicles for your needs.
Flexible access without heavy capital outlay.
steps: We review your fleet and goals.
faqs: Can you manage vehicles I already own?
Tell us about your fleet in the form and we will advise.
Is tracking included?
Tracking is available as an add-on through AAR Tracking.

services.title: Vehicle Tracking
services.short: AAR Tracking for cars, fleets and assets.
services.sub: AAR Tracking offers a wide range of vehicle tracking solutions built on our automotive experience.
services.lead: Protect vehicles, cut misuse and respond faster when something goes wrong.
points: Solutions for personal cars and company fleets
Useful for asset and equipment monitoring
Advice on the right option for you
features: Keep an eye on your own car.
Faster help if a vehicle is stranded.
steps: Tell us what you want to track.
A trained team fits the device.
faqs: Can I track a single car?
Yes. Choose personal car in the form.
Does it work with fleet reporting?
Ask our team about reporting for your size of fleet.

about.title: About Us
about.h1: Putting people first on Nigeria's roads
about.sub: A multi-service company founded in 2003 to bring comfort, remove distress and protect Nigerians on the road.
about.who: AA Rescue began with prompt emergency roadside assistance for stranded motorists. We are a pioneer of modern driving training and automobile rescue in Nigeria, and we have grown into a company that serves individuals, families and corporate organisations.
list: Corporate transport and road traffic consultancy
about.mission: To instil and engrave the right motoring culture in Nigeria.
about.vision: To greatly enhance safety and give comfort to motorists, applying our peculiar skills through every commercial and social landscape.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.sub: Emergency or enquiry, a real person answers. We are open every day of the year.
faqs: How do I request urgent roadside rescue?
Call 0802 555 1111 at any time. For non-urgent requests use the rescue form on our Vehicle Recovery page.
Where are you based?
Our corporate head office is in Lekki, Lagos. We have 17 branches across Nigeria.
Can I pay online?
Use the Make Payment page and we will send you a secure payment link.

book-car.title: Book Your Car
book-car.sub: Choose a vehicle, add your trip details and we confirm availability and price by phone.

make-payment.title: Make Payment
make-payment.sub: Pay for AA Rescue services safely. Share the details and we send a secure link.
